Constructors

RasterizerStateDesc()

Initializes a new instance of the RasterizerStateDesc struct with default settings. Back-face culling enabled, solid fill mode; all optional features disabled; depth bias zero.

public RasterizerStateDesc()

RasterizerStateDesc(CullMode, bool, FillMode)

Initializes a new instance of the RasterizerStateDesc struct, specifying the culling and fill modes. All other properties retain default values (e.g., back-face culling, solid fill, no depth bias).

public RasterizerStateDesc(CullMode cullingMode, bool enableScissors = false, FillMode fillMode = FillMode.Solid)

Parameters

cullingMode CullMode

The primitive culling mode (None, Front, or Back). Default: Back.

enableScissors bool

When true, the scissor rectangles are enabled.

fillMode FillMode

The polygon fill mode (Solid or Wireframe). Default: Solid.

Fields

AntialiasedLineEnabled

Enables or disables anti-aliasing for line primitives (e.g., smooth edges on lines). Note: This may not be supported on all hardware or API versions (e.g., D3D12 ignores it).

public bool AntialiasedLineEnabled

Field Value

bool

Cull

Specifies which primitives are culled during rasterization. Common values include Back (default), Front, and None for no culling.

public CullMode Cull

Field Value

CullMode

DepthBias

Constant depth bias added to the depth value of each rasterized pixel. Used to prevent z-fighting in shadow mapping and other techniques where geometry overlaps. Positive values push fragments away from the camera; negative pulls them closer.

public float DepthBias

Field Value

float

DepthBiasClamp

Maximum clamp value for depth bias (to prevent extreme over-biasing). The actual applied bias is DepthBias + SlopeScaledDepthBias × max_slope, clamped to this range.

public float DepthBiasClamp

Field Value

float

DepthClipEnabled

Enables or disables depth clipping (required for correct viewport transform and clip volume). When disabled, depth values may exceed the [0,1] range without clipping — useful for advanced techniques like inverted Z buffers or custom projection setups.

public bool DepthClipEnabled

Field Value

bool

Fill

Specifies how primitives are filled during rasterization. Common values include Solid (default) for solid polygons, and Wireframe for wireframe rendering.

public FillMode Fill

Field Value

FillMode

FrontCounterClockwise

Determines whether front-facing primitives have counter-clockwise vertex ordering. When true, the front face is defined by vertices in counter-clockwise order (D3D convention). Set to false for clockwise-front-face behavior (e.g., when using OpenGL-style geometry). Only effective if Cull is not None.

public bool FrontCounterClockwise

Field Value

bool

MultisampleEnabled

Enables or disables multisample anti-aliasing (MSAA) during rasterization. When enabled, per-sample coverage is computed; otherwise, single-sample rendering occurs. Only effective when the render target supports MSAA.

public bool MultisampleEnabled

Field Value

bool

ScissorEnabled

Enables or disables the scissor test, which restricts rendering to a rectangular region. When enabled, pixels outside the configured scissor rectangle are discarded.

public bool ScissorEnabled

Field Value

bool

SlopeScaledDepthBias

Depth bias scaled by the polygon's slope (e.g., steep surfaces receive greater bias). Combined with DepthBias and clamped by DepthBiasClamp. Critical for high-quality shadow maps — typically set to 0.0f or small negative values.

public float SlopeScaledDepthBias

Field Value

float
